hero.label: Get involved
hero.lede: Shakedia Jones is running for 1st Ward Alderman, and this campaign runs on neighbors. Carry a petition, talk with the people on your block, put a sign in your yard. Every bit of help makes the 1st Ward stronger.
hero.now_text: Petitions are how a candidate gets on the ballot. Volunteers help gather signatures from 1st Ward voters.

ways.label: Ways to help
ways.lede: Choose one, choose three, or tell us how much time you have and we will find the right fit.
ways.petition_text: Petitions are how a candidate gets on the ballot, and volunteers help gather signatures from 1st Ward voters. Sign one, or gather signatures on your own block.
ways.petition_rules: Petition signers must be registered voters in the 1st Ward. Circulators must meet state eligibility rules; we will train you before you start.
ways.doors_text: The best campaign is a neighbor on the porch. We give you a short list, a few talking points and a partner.
ways.sign_text: One sign in one window starts the conversation on a whole block. We drop it off.
ways.events_text: Set up tables, greet neighbors, hand out water at the park. Every event needs a crew.
ways.words_title: Spread the word in Spanish and English
ways.words_text: Share posts, translate a flyer, talk about the campaign with your neighbors, team or group chat, in whichever language they speak.
ways.give_text: Any amount buys clipboards, flyers and yard signs. Small gifts from neighbors go the farthest.

form.label: Sign up
form.lede: Tell us a little about yourself and how you would like to help. A real person from the campaign will get back to you.
form.how_email: When you press the button, your email app opens with your details filled in. Just press send.
form.contact_hint: A phone number or an email, whichever you check more.
form.ward_label: Do you live in the 1st Ward?
form.ward_no: No, but I want to help
form.msg_ph: Times you are free, questions, ideas
form.error: Please add your name and a phone number or email so we can reach you.
form.note_email: This opens your email app with your sign-up ready. Nothing is sent until you press send.
form.thanks_email: Check your email app: your sign-up is ready. Press send and we will be in touch soon.
form.soon_text: The volunteer form is almost ready. Check back here soon to join the team.
form.lede_soon: Petitions, doors, yard signs, events: there is a place for everyone. The sign-up form opens right here soon.

donate.label: Chip in
donate.lede: This campaign runs on neighbors, not big checks. Your gift pays for petition clipboards, flyers in Spanish and English, and yard signs for the 1st Ward.
donate.button_note: Opens our secure donation page in a new tab.
donate.legal: Contributions to Friends of Shakedia Jones are not tax deductible. Contributions over $150 are itemized in reports filed with the Illinois State Board of Elections. Contributions must be made from your own funds; contributions from foreign nationals are prohibited.

vote.label: Before you vote
vote.lede: The primary is Tuesday, February 23, 2027, and the general election follows on Tuesday, April 6, 2027. The Lake County Clerk runs elections here and keeps every deadline up to date, so check with them directly.
vote.primary_note: The first date to circle. Plan your vote now.
vote.general_note: The consolidated election for city offices.
vote.clerk_text: One stop for everything before you vote:
vote.clerk_link: Lake County Clerk: register and find your polling place
vote.newtab_note: Opens the Clerk's website in a new tab.

share.label: Spread the word
share.lede: A text to a neighbor takes ten seconds and keeps the 1st Ward talking.
